domains.title: STM32U575 USBX / ThreadX
domains.summary: USB controller, CDC transfers, ThreadX waits, error reports, control queue and allocator pressure.
domains.requires: STM32U575 SVD and matching USBX CDC ACM / ThreadX Debug ELF

domains.title: STM32N6 Ethernet / lwIP
domains.summary: Follow frames from the MAC through DMA descriptors and lwIP; distinguish receive pressure, wire errors and stack drops.
domains.requires: STM32N657 ETH_S / RCC_S SVD and exact N6 demo ELF / lwIP layout

domains.title: STM32WB six-axis IMU
domains.summary: Sensor samples, configuration and consumption rate reveal a stalled reader, bus errors or a reader falling behind the sensor.
domains.requires: STM32WB5MM-DK ISM330DHCX firmware mirrors, matching ELF and STM32WB55_CM4 SVD

domains.title: Joulescope power channels
domains.summary: Group imported MCU current and power traces under Power.
domains.requires: Existing external MCU current / MCU power channels; recorder or import pipeline supplied separately

domains.title: BLE overview
domains.summary: Connection, command outcomes, retained errors, service registrations and observer capacity.
domains.requires: STM32WB BLE observation ABI 1 and matching Debug ELF

domains.title: BLE GATT slots 0 and 1
domains.summary: Registered characteristic identity, properties, retained values, subscriptions and write/update outcomes.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; characteristic slots 0 and 1 must be populated to show values

domains.title: BLE GATT slots 2 and 3
domains.summary: Registered characteristic identity, properties, retained values, subscriptions and write/update outcomes.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; characteristic slots 2 and 3 must be populated to show values

domains.title: BLE GATT slots 4 and 5
domains.summary: Registered characteristic identity, properties, retained values, subscriptions and write/update outcomes.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; characteristic slots 4 and 5 must be populated to show values

domains.title: BLE GATT slots 6 and 7
domains.summary: Registered characteristic identity, properties, retained values, subscriptions and write/update outcomes.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; characteristic slots 6 and 7 must be populated to show values

domains.title: BLE ST peer-to-peer profile
domains.summary: LED/button state, skipped notifications and an explicit application-mediated LED command.
domains.requires: ST P2P symbols; command mailbox ABI 1 and typed-actions-v1 for Send in BKPT Debug

domains.title: BLE STM32WB shared transport
domains.summary: Application snapshots of IPCC channel flags and the M4 interrupt mask.
domains.requires: STM32WB BLE observation ABI 1; firmware must refresh IPCC snapshots

domains.title: BLE activity slots 0-7
domains.summary: Retained command outcomes and significant asynchronous events in eight physical journal slots.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; combine both journal pages for the 16-slot retained window

domains.title: BLE activity slots 8-15
domains.summary: Retained command outcomes and significant asynchronous events in eight physical journal slots.
domains.requires: BLE observation ABI 1; combine both journal pages for the 16-slot retained window

domains.title: IMU channel styling example
domains.summary: A presentation-only template for user_trace channels; no matching firmware producer is supplied.
domains.requires: Adapt to actual recorder channel names and units; not STM32WB sensor support

domains.title: Packet counter example
domains.summary: Wrapping counters, a derived rate and an error-count finding.
domains.requires: Firmware must supply packets_completed and packet_errors

domains.title: Ethernet authoring example
domains.summary: Guarded registers, descriptor ownership and backlog checks for a placeholder MAC.
domains.requires: Replace ExampleMCU registers and ring layout with verified target definitions

domains.title: Middleware queue example
domains.summary: Structured pointers, occupancy/capacity cards and consumer-progress checks.
domains.requires: Implement or map active_queue, queue_slots, queue_enqueued and queue_drained

domains.title: Typed actions example
domains.summary: RAM writes, an application mailbox and a register-field action.
domains.requires: Implement matching firmware/mailbox/SVD; actions require explicit debugger Send

domains.title: Instrument sidecar example
domains.summary: External current samples and a high-current threshold.
domains.requires: Supply sensor-recorder executable and synchronization channel; no sidecar included
